bagPolicy.summary: Bags and luggage over 25 liters are not allowed. Cloakrooms at the entrances can hold backpacks, umbrellas and helmets.
allowed: Bags and backpacks up to 25 liters
bagPolicy.note: Cloakrooms are open at the venue entrances during events for items you cannot take inside. No price is listed.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at Movistar Arena can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Movistar Arena. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.note: Movistar Arena offers a diverse range of food and drink options, including hot dogs from Oscar Mayer, pizzas from Papa Johns, and iberico products from Navidul. Vegan options are available at Better Balance, and mobile service is provided by BEBERAPID for convenience.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The accessible entrance is at Doors 14 and 15.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Movistar Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Movistar Arena. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Movistar Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
